question: Shambhu Maharaj was Awarded the Padma Shri for his contribution to which of the following dances in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shambhu Maharaj**

 
 
• The **Lucknow Gharana (school)**, which practices the Indian classical dance style known as Kathak, was led by Pandit Shambhu Maharaj.
 
• Of the two older brothers, **Achchan Maharaj and Luchchu Maharaj, he was the youngest**.
